name: OmaNetMonitor
author: linuxg33k76
description: Watches outbound TCP connections and flags any whose remote IP geolocates outside your allowed countries/regions.

barWidget.description: Bar icon that turns urgent-colored when an outbound connection is talking to an IP outside your allowed countries. Click it to see the top 10 flagged IPs, their country, and port.

schema.label: Allowed countries
schema.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes that should NOT be flagged (e.g. "US" or "US,CA,MX").
